item.title: Update of Author Guidelines and Submission Template
item.description: The Journal of Airline and Airport Management (JAIRM) is pleased to announce several updates to its author guidelines and manuscript preparation requirements. These changes aim to improve transparency, align the journal with current international academic standards, and facilitate consistency in manuscript submission and publication.Updated Manuscript TemplateA new manuscript template has been introduced and must be used for all new submissions. Authors are required to prepare their manuscripts
